meta_description:
67K likes, 738 comments - foodpharmer on October 19, 2026: "India’s YELLOW Water Crisis! 

Nashik’s groundwater has a shocking story that every Indian needs to know!

A lab report found Chromium 6, a cancer-causing chemical, in a water sample at 1,000 times the permissible limit.

Around 80 metal-plating industries operate in the area, and industrial pollution is linked to this groundwater contamination.

Medical screening has also identified skin diseases and allergies among 109 people.

Millions of pilgrims are expected at the 2027 Nashik Kumbh Mela, we cannot afford to turn a blind eye to this crisis.

Please share this video, especially with people in Maharashtra. The more people who know about this crisis, the harder it becomes to ignore.

The people of Nashik deserve answers, accountability, and immediate action.

Let’s make India’s water safe again!

Visuals from @thebetterindia".
